name: nerdctl
description: nerdctl — Docker-compatible CLI for containerd. Same interface as docker but for containerd.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/releases/latest/download/nerdctl-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf nerdctl-linux-amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv nerdctl /usr/local/bin/ && rm nerdctl-linux-amd64.tar.gz
